instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk next to a river, four friends stand in a circle stacking their hands in a huddle. In the left foreground, the man in the gray t-shirt (R3) is seen from a back-three-quarters view extending his arm. On the right, the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) stands in profile, smiling as she reaches her hand in. In the background, the woman in the gray hijab (R1) smiles from the left, and the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands in the center, smiling down at their joined hands. Warm, natural sunlight filters through the trees, casting a soft glow over the scene.
elements: R3 extends his arm into the stacked-hand huddle rather than R2 doing that foreground arm-extension role
R4 reaches her hand into the stack in profile rather than R1 filling that reaching-in profile role
R2 stands in the center smiling down at the joined hands rather than R3 taking that center-looking-down role
R1, R2, R3, and R4 participate in a circular stacked-hands huddle
R3 and R4 both contribute hands toward the same central hand stack
the huddle occurs on an outdoor wooden boardwalk next to a river
